signal: PeopleInsight by HireRoad published its State of People Analytics 2025-2026 report and continues expanding its workforce analytics platform

email.body1:
Matthew, saw PeopleInsight by HireRoad push the State of People Analytics report and keep expanding the platform.

That kind of category push usually surfaces more in-market HR and talent teams than your reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PeopleInsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for PeopleInsight.

A stronger market position usually lifts the revenue number faster than headcount can. Most CROs do not actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PeopleInsight needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for PeopleInsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PeopleInsight's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and driving a category narrative is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to PeopleInsight either way.
